test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines command opcodes, address-cycle counts, status-register bits, parameter-page layout, multi-LUN / multi-plane operation rules, and behavioural-flow state machines (Section 7) that map directly to compliance scenarios; ONFI does not publish a formal compliance test plan in the spec itself, but the four founding vendors maintain internal qualification suites.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior — Reset (FFh) from any state returns target to Idle, SDR data interface, timing mode 0, R/B_n LOW for tRST then HIGH.
Synchronous Reset (FCh) — preserves the active NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 data interface and timing mode.
Reset LUN (FAh) — resets only the addressed LUN; other LUNs continue operations.
Read ID (90h) — address 00h returns ≥ 4 ID bytes; address 20h returns 'ONFI' signature; address 40h returns 'JEDEC' signature.
Read Parameter Page (ECh + 00h) — 256-byte page; byte 0-3 = 'ONFI'; byte 254-255 = CRC; CRC validates with polynomial 8005h, init 4F4Eh.
Parameter Page redundancy — three copies at bytes 0-255 / 256-511 / 512-767 shall be identical; host shall iterate copies on CRC mismatch.
Extended Parameter Page — when section type 2 present, ECC info reported with codeword size + correctability; signature 'EPPS' at bytes 2-5.
Read Unique ID (EDh + 00h) — 16 × (16-byte UID + 16-byte complement); UID XOR complement = all ones for at least one of the 16 copies.
Read (00h + 5 addr + 30h) — array → page register in tR; FAIL bit 0 = 0 on raw NAND; on EZ NAND FAIL valid for Read.
Read Cache Random / Sequential / End (00h/31h, 31h, 3Fh) — pipelined read; data emerges on DQ during cache pipeline.
Change Read Column (05h + 2 col + E0h) — repositions read pointer within current page register; tCCS applies before next data.
Change Read Column Enhanced (06h + 5 addr + E0h) — like Change Read Column but with full row address (for multi-LUN page-register access).
Block Erase (60h + 3 row + D0h) — erases block; R/B_n LOW for tBERS; FAIL bit reports outcome.
Erase of factory-marked bad block — device shall NOT proceed; FAIL bit set.
Page Program (80h + 5 addr + data + 10h) — programs page register to array; R/B_n LOW for tPROG; FAIL bit reports outcome.
Page Cache Program (80h + 5 addr + data + 15h) — pipelined program; FAILC reports prior-command result after second 15h or 10h.
Copyback Read + Program (00h/35h + 5 addr + 85h/10h) — on-die copy without host data path.
Small Data Move (85h + 5 addr + write data + 10h) — modify subset of bytes in page register before commit.
Multi-plane Page Program (80h + plane0 + data + 11h + 80h + plane1 + data + 10h) — concurrent plane programming.
Multi-plane Block Erase (60h + plane0 + D1h + 60h + plane1 + D0h) — concurrent plane erase.
Multi-plane Read (00h + plane0 + 32h + 00h + plane1 + 30h) — concurrent plane read.
Read Status (70h) — returns composite status byte; bit 6 RDY, bit 0 FAIL.
Read Status Enhanced (78h + 3 row addr) — per-LUN/plane status; turns off other LUN output buffers; required during multi-LUN poll.
Status bit invalidation — RDY=0 invalidates SR[5:0] (WP_n still valid).
WP_n write protect — WP_n LOW disables Program/Erase; Read still permitted.
WP_n stability — WP_n shall not transition during active Program/Erase or while Write Enable is active.
Set Features (EFh + addr + 4 P-bytes) / Get Features (EEh + addr) — round-trip of timing mode, drive strength, ODT, training settings.
Timing-mode change (Set Features 01h) — host switches SDR→NV-DDR→NV-DDR2→NV-DDR3 progressively; verify data transfer in each mode.
ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) — after Reset; tZQCL ≥ 1 µs; FAIL bit reports outcome.
ZQ Calibration Short (D9h) — periodic; tZQCS per timing mode.
Volume Select (E1h + Vol_Addr) — CE_n pin reduction directing; preceded by Volume Appointment via Set Features (58h).
ODT Configure (E2h) — matrix termination state per LUN: Deselected / Selected / Sniff.
Multi-LUN parallelism — issue Read on LUN0 then Page Program on LUN1; both R/B_n LOW; poll each with Read Status Enhanced.
Power-on reset — Vcc/VccQ ramp, WP_n LOW or HIGH per board, host issues Reset (FFh) ≥ tCRY; first Reset takes up to 5 ms (vs 500 µs subsequent).
Staggered power-up — Section 2.14; multi-target sharing one Vcc rail with controlled ramp.
DCC Training (NV-DDR3) — Implicit DCC Training (18h) corrects internal clock duty cycle.
Read DQ Training (62h, NV-DDR3) — host sweeps RX sampling phase against device-driven training pattern.
Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern / 64h readback, NV-DDR3) — round-trip pattern verification for TX adjustment.
Write RX DQ Training (76h, NV-DDR3) — device-side RX training.
Bad block discovery — Section 3.3 factory defect mapping; first read after manufacture flags marked blocks.
Extended ECC Information — when ECC correctability > 0xFE, host reads Extended Parameter Page section type 2.
Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16) — DQ_0 and DQ_1 operate in parallel; per-bus DQS and ODT.
tCCS adherence — after second address byte of Change Read/Write Column, host shall wait ≥ tCCS before data cycles.
Reset Status during boot — first Reset (FFh) may take up to 5 ms; subsequent resets ≤ 500 µs.
